answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the meadow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the walnut until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the copper of the next round. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
